SCOPE: outcome-blind feasibility on 2023-2024 only; no outcome on any symbol; no byte dated 2025 or later
PANEL_RULE: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE UM perps: the symbols with checked bookDepth from 2023-01-01; fixed before counting; no symbol added or dropped after counting
DETECTOR: SEED0001_DETECTOR_V1 unchanged (scripts/research/seed0001_regular_divergence_lib.py); BTC and ETH must reproduce the frozen SEED-0001 episode digests. If SEED-0003 changes any definition, this feasibility must be re-run before any protected opening.
SECONDARY_ESTIMAND: A - B (does divergence add value conditional on support)
ESTIMAND_RELATIONSHIP: interaction primary, A - B secondary; frozen now and again in SEED-0003 before protected data are opened; never chosen after outcomes
PLANNED_INFERENCE: episode-level linear probability model Y ~ 1 + A + B + C (D reference) + symbol fixed effects (+ the SEED-0003 covariates); CR1 cluster-robust variance with panel-wide UTC-week clusters (all symbols in a week form one cluster), t(G - 1); primary two-sided alpha 0.05 with a positive estimate required
DEPENDENCE_ASSUMPTIONS: episodes on different symbols are NOT independent: all symbols in a UTC week share one inference cluster, which allows arbitrary within-week correlation across symbols, arms and overlapping windows
residual dependence across week boundaries (windows up to 96h) is a known limitation and is reported (48h chains, boundary straddling)

power is computed under explicit cross-symbol shocks (BASE: per UTC date across symbols and arms; STRESS: per (UTC date, arm) across symbols, latent ICC 0.50) and on a COLLAPSED layout that merges same-day same-arm episodes into one unit
a panel that is feasible only under INDEPENDENT fails

DIAGNOSTIC_EFFECT_ROLES.0.20: stress / easy case; passing only at 0.20 never authorizes opening

FROZEN_RULES.PLANNING_ALTERNATIVE: p = 0.5 in B, C, D and 0.5 + delta in A, so the interaction and A - B both equal delta

BASE.ROLE: one probit shock per UTC decision date shared by all symbols and arms

STRESS.ROLE: GATE: one shock per (UTC date, arm) shared across symbols; same-day same-arm episodes move together

COLLAPSED_PROFILE.ROLE: diagnostic lower bound: same-day same-arm episodes merged into one unit across symbols

FROZEN_RULES.PROJECTED_LAYOUTS: the first and the last 85-week runs of the 2023-2024 panel layout (the spend window spans 85 week blocks); the gate uses the minimum STRESS power over both
VERDICT_ORDER: DATA_BLOCKED: a panel symbol misses a kline month or has book-hour coverage below 0.95
INFERENCE_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT: a projected layout has < 30 week clusters containing A, or < 30 containing C
STRUCTURAL_INFERENCE_RISK: one symbol holds > 50% of A episodes
INFORMATIONALLY_WEAK: STRESS power of the interaction at 0.15 < 0.80 on either projected layout
FROZEN_RULES.IF_NOT_FEASIBLE: stop after feasibility, report the required sample/history, do not spend the holdout
FROZEN_RULES.REQUIRED_HISTORY: STRESS power at 0.15 on the 2023-2024 layout stacked k times (independent copies; optimistic), k in 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10

SPEND_WINDOW_CONDITIONAL.E1_RULE: no input window, baseline, feature construction, outcome horizon or auxiliary calculation may touch the E1 holdout; the last decision plus 96h ends at least one day before it, and trailing baselines only look backward
OPENING_REQUIRES: a frozen SEED-0003 twin prereg covering every item of the owner list
policy documents updated in the opening decision
